notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Update 1.1:

Language:
Added support for 6 languages:
	Italian
	Russian
	Turkish
	Chinese
	Korean
	Japanese

Content:
Fixed checkpoints respawning ball slightly inside level.
Made the drone ambience in World 3 quieter.
Fixed shadow caster on a couple of balls.
Rotated checkpoint #1 on Ambidextrous 90 degrees (Should make the lighting line up with the obstacle there better.)

Other:
The apply video button in the video options menu now resets the level, or main menu.

If you happen upon any bugs let me know, and I'll try to get them fixed post-haste. The best way to do so is via the contact page, ( http://ProjectileEntertainment.com/contact )
